{{Quote|I miss your former Master too. We lost many friends on Geonosis.|Ring-Sol Ambase, to Nuru Kungurama|<ref name="SM1" />}}
'''Lanchu Skaa''' was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Sometime before or during the [[Time/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], he took the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Nuru Kungurama]] as his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]]. In 22 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was captured on a mission to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] and Skaa was part of a [[Jedi assault team/Legends|Jedi task force]] sent to the planet to rescue Kenobi, who had been sentenced to [[Death/Legends|death]]. Skaa was killed in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|ensuing battle]], which sparked the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|And I should have given you my condolences for Lanchu Skaa. I was with your late Master when he was felled on Geonosis.|Jedi Master Kit Fisto, to Nuru Kungurama|<ref name="Strange Allies">''[[The Clone Wars: Strange Allies]]''</ref>}}
[[File:NuruKungurama-ERC.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Nuru Kungurama, Skaa's apprentice]]
Lanchu<ref name="SM2">''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 2: Curse of the Black Hole Pirates]]''</ref> Skaa was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] who lived during the last [[Standard year/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Skaa was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and eventually reached the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]].<ref name="SM1" /> By [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC" /> he took the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Nuru Kungurama]] as his [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]].<ref name="SM1" /> 

That year,<ref name="TNEC" /> [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was captured by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], and the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] sent a [[Jedi assault team/Legends|task force]] to rescue Kenobi from [[Death/Legends|execution]].<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> Master Skaa was part of the strike team and left his Padawan without a chance to say goodbye. Skaa was killed during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|mission]] while with Jedi Master [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]]. During the ensuing [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] fought between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy, fellow Jedi Master [[Ring-Sol Ambase]] accepted Kungurama as his Padawan and both Ambase and Kungurama mourned the death of Skaa.<ref name="SM1" /> Later during the war, in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Strange Allies Date">[[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] is the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] during the events of ''[[The Clone Wars: Strange Allies]]''. Thus ''Strange Allies'' must take place between the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episodes "[[Monster]]" and "[[Witches of the Mist]]" which are both dated to [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] per ''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 48]]''.</ref> Fisto briefly spoke with Kungurama about his late master. During the exchange, Fisto apologized to Kungurama for not offering his condolences immediately after the Battle of Geonosis.<ref name="Strange Allies" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|If there had been more time, Master Skaa would have said farewell. You know that.|Ring-Sol Ambase, to Nuru Kungurama|<ref name="SM1" />}}
Although Skaa left Nuru Kungurama without saying farewell, both Ring-Sol Ambase and Kungurama believed that he would have done so if he had had the time. Both liked Skaa and felt immense grief after the death of the Jedi Master.<ref name="SM1" />

==Powers and abilities==
Skaa possessed the knowledge and the skills required to become a Jedi Master. Although he was a trained Jedi, he was killed during the Battle of Geonosis<ref name="SM1" /> like many other Jedi.<ref name="AOTC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lanchu Skaa was first mentioned in ''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 1: Breakout Squad]]'', a [[2009]] novel written by [[Ryder Windham]] as part of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Secret Missions]]'' book series.<ref name="SM1" /> Skaa's first name was introduced in the following novel, [[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 2: Curse of the Black Hole Pirates|''Curse of the Black Hole Pirates'']], also written by Windham and released in [[2010]].<ref name="SM2" />
